overall_observations: Reference outputs visibly follow donor palette and background, but transfer is entangled with faces, markings and shape changes.
Latent outputs exhibit strong visible variation including species-associated recoloring, background replacement, clutter and distorted forms.
Self-style controls also change details, showing a reconstruction/preservation limitation beyond cross-domain styling.
Largest RMS tails include strong background inversion; low-diversity tails still vary visibly and are not exact-collapse evidence.
limits: These labels are descriptive observations, not class accuracy or a prevalence estimate.
Source identity is uncertain without independent verification; no semantic-diversity, FID or augmentation-benefit claim.
Milestones were inspected descriptively; final checkpoint was fixed by iteration count, not selected for appearance.
